title: Earlier weatherman burned by tall white suits at Range Four
place_text: Range Four, Indian Springs Valley; Nellis hospital, Nevada

tellings.quote: and the suit and his shoulder almost touched one of the shoes. And I saw his x-rays and pictures.

plain: In 1965, a weatherman who worked at Range Four, a site in Nevada's Indian Springs Valley, was burned after he came too close to tall, white-skinned beings in suits; his shoulder, it is said, "almost touched one of the shoes." The story comes from Charles Hall, who tells Michels that he later spent three years as a weatherman at Area 51 living alongside beings he calls tall white aliens, and who says he saw the injured man's "x-rays and pictures" at the Nellis hospital in Nevada. If true, it would mean these beings and US military staff were in physical contact, and that the medical records showed the harm.
